policy: Each public EKODI service must have a distinct visual family. Share accessibility, responsive behavior, EKODI identity, navigation conventions and the public-before-auth/member-workspace boundary, but do not clone palette, card geometry, typography hierarchy or information rhythm across services.

mustKeep: member boundary for real workspaces and personal data

cafe.palette: foam white / sand / warm wood / deep sea / twilight violet
cafe.geometry: harbor arcs, long-table cards, soft spatial panels
cafe.rule: future-place storytelling first; never imply the physical cafe is already operating

publishing.palette: warm paper / carbon ink / copper / muted teal
publishing.geometry: production sheets, manuscript stages, proof marks, workflow rails
publishing.rule: present publishing consultation, production, agency, distribution and studio as one independent professional platform; keep bookstore commerce and catalog identity separate

lab.palette: warm paper / graphite / oxide orange / data blue
lab.migration: move away from green-dominant styling to avoid Church/Community overlap

messenger.palette: deep navy / luminous teal / soft ice
messenger.geometry: thread lanes, presence dots, handoff rails
messenger.rule: conversation first; actions deep-link to the owning EKODI service

energy.palette: deep ink / sunlight amber / leaf green / cool current blue
energy.type: wide modern sans + numeric telemetry accents

business.geometry: briefing bands, action gates, rectangular operator panels

management.geometry: decision paths, next-step cards, soft panels
management.rule: lead with the user's management problem and next action; do not begin with module lists

bible.palette: warm ivory / fresh mint / soft apricot / lilac / deep ink
bible.type: friendly humanist sans + gentle editorial accents
bible.geometry: question chips, soft cards, conversation bubbles, journey steps
bible.rule: life-first and question-led; Scripture, AI reflection and personal sharing must remain clearly distinguished

life.palette: cloud white / soft cobalt / coral / mint
life.type: friendly display sans + calm reading sans
life.geometry: question cards, branching paths, reflection dots
life.rule: begin with a human life question, then connect to appropriate EKODI services or Scripture without overwhelming the user

delivery.palette: warm white / route blue / tangerine / fresh green
delivery.geometry: route chips, dispatch cards, status lanes
delivery.rule: show the next operational action before internal dispatch complexity

mall.geometry: product tiles, sticker badges, rounded image frames
mall.status: implemented in canonical sites/ekodi-mall on design/distinct-user-ui-20260816

marketing.geometry: campaign canvases, split previews, kinetic cards

trade.geometry: route lines, quote tables, terminal panels

invest.type: editorial financial sans + mono evidence labels
invest.geometry: dossier sheets, diligence checklists, thesis/risk columns
invest.rule: analysis and connection only; never imply execution, custody, guaranteed returns, or regulated brokerage

edu.geometry: lesson blocks, progress rails, notebook cues

my.palette: night blue / soft cyan / warm white
my.geometry: personal activity lanes and modular home cards

mail.geometry: message rows, clean dividers, restrained panels

live.geometry: stage frames, live rails, audience strips

cloud.palette: cloud white / steel blue / deep ink
cloud.geometry: file shelves, workspace tiles, breadcrumb rails

mission.rule: legacy naming/route only; do not create a second visual family
